project_type: Python research module for SDR-to-HDR reshaping (numpy/scipy/opencv)
build_system: pip install -e '.[dev]' from repo root; research module uses sys.path manipulation
test_framework: pytest with conftest.py; production tests in tests/, research tests in research/tests/
verification_instructions: Run production tests (pytest tests/) to confirm no regressions. Research deliverable is a markdown analysis document, verified by running the analysis script that generates it.
snapshot_or_generated_files: research/reports/RESEARCH_REPORT.md is generated by run_comparison.py but checked in. New deliverable will be research/physical_validation/root_cause/ROOT_CAUSE_ANALYSIS.md
environment_constraints: No real video frames available in sandbox. No actual MMR-1 outputs, H0 outputs, or Phase 8 render results. All analysis must use synthetic data from research/synthetic_scenes.py or create new synthetic scenes that simulate the failure conditions (creative regrade with content-dependent color relationships). Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Network mode allows package installation.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify production code in src/. Do NOT create new production models. Do NOT modify existing research module files. Create new files only in research/physical_validation/root_cause/. The deliverable is a diagnostic research document.
key_patterns: research/models.py: ModelE (12-pt CDF+regularized, luminance ratio scaling). research/synthetic_scenes.py: generates (hdr_full, sdr_openmatte, hdr_region_slice) tuples. research/color_utils.py: PQ/gamma/gamut conversions. research/metrics.py: deltaE2000, RMSE, seam metrics. src/auto_openmatte/processing/transform.py: production pipeline (linearize, BT709->BT2020, luma curve, color matrix, saturation, PQ). Model application uses luminance ratio scaling which preserves hue ratios but cannot handle content-dependent chroma transformations.
directory_structure: src/auto_openmatte/ = production pipeline code. research/ = research module with models, synthetic scenes, metrics. research/reports/ = generated reports. research/physical_validation/root_cause/ = new directory for this phase's deliverable.
